description: Compact true-wireless earbuds with 24-hour battery life (with case), active noise cancellation, and touch controls. Comes with 3 sizes of silicone ear tips for a secure fit.
Ultra-thin shock-absorbing case for iPhone 14 with raised edges to protect the camera and screen. Available in clear, black, and navy.
Fitness smartwatch with heart-rate monitoring, sleep tracking, 7-day battery life, and a 1.4-inch AMOLED display. Water resistant up to 50 meters.
Palm-sized Bluetooth speaker with surprisingly deep bass, IPX6 water resistance, and 12-hour playtime. Pairs with a second Boom Mini for stereo sound.
Aluminum laptop stand with 6 adjustable height and angle positions, improves posture and airflow. Folds flat for travel and fits laptops from 10 to 17 inches.
Compact USB-C hub with HDMI 4K output, 2 USB-A ports, SD/microSD card reader, and 100W USB-C power delivery pass-through.
Compact 87-key mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches, RGB backlighting, and a detachable USB-C cable. Ships with tactile brown switches by default.
Full HD 1080p webcam with autofocus, a built-in privacy shutter, and dual noise-cancelling microphones. Plug-and-play via USB, no drivers needed.
High-capacity 20000mAh power bank with 20W USB-C fast charging, supports charging two devices at once. Can fully charge most phones 4-5 times.
Lightweight fitness band with step counting, heart-rate monitoring, and 10-day battery life. Syncs with a companion app over Bluetooth.
